ActorTalk: You know, I've never been good with goodbyes, especially the final ones.
I know they're part of life, though. Especially since... the reason I'm still breathing and fighting today is because of the friends and family who gave everything for me.
These names... they must have meant the world to people, too.
That's why I'm saying them out loud. I just feel like... when I speak them, they stop being just letters on a wall, you know?
There's one more person who remembers them because of you.
Thanks, Commandant. I knew you'd get it.
